decision_scope: Frozen delivery/continuation account; no new modeling, acceptance, engineering or release authority.
summary: The Windows repair and retained-release account preserve authority and custody boundaries. Remaining limitations are explicit. Future public-file admission needs a stronger negative test.
independence: Separate safety prompt; peer reports unseen. Shared inherited model/history and repository sources; no protected holdout.
own_checks: All ten frozen source SHA-256 values match
Read-only repair, allowlist, ignore and authority inspection

findings.claim: Delivery authorization does not authorize a fourth modeling loop, mechanics, paid Replit or artistic acceptance.
findings.consequence: Scope or spending could expand without owner direction.
findings.smallest_decisive_test: Before implementation, bind selected scope to owner authority and MB-T062's operational drill.

findings.claim: Code remains MIT; creative content remains all rights reserved. Private archives and this report are ignored.
findings.consequence: Custody could be mistaken for reuse rights or publication approval.
findings.smallest_decisive_test: Repeat exact source/rights and ignored-path checks for any changed publication selection.

findings.claim: Supplied receipts support exact GitHub/Pages and isolated-preview identity; Replit parent and connectors remain unresolved.
findings.consequence: A blanket synchronization claim would conceal 17 untriaged parent-only commits and unauthorized connectors.
findings.smallest_decisive_test: At resume, read actual isolated checkout and served /cg.html revision; separately inventory parent preservation and connector authorization.

findings.claim: Native-path entry detection and narrow LF rules repair the documented Windows failure without changing imported creative bytes.
findings.consequence: 58-file output or CRLF drift could recur on another checkout.
findings.smallest_decisive_test: On a newly supported host, clean checkout/build and compare all 154 payload identities; no universal portability certification.

findings.claim: Static retained GLBs, pending owner acceptance, unmet likeness and strict-normal FAIL remain distinct from V37 behavior and delivery success.
findings.consequence: Successful transport could become unsupported artistic, motion or device acceptance.
findings.smallest_decisive_test: Use applicable source-matched evaluation and explicit owner decision; execute named-device/accessibility scenarios separately.

findings.claim: The validator admits every public file except banned patterns; the CG subset has an exact allowlist. No leak is observed in the supplied inventory.
findings.consequence: A future misplaced ordinary public file could pass boundary validation.
findings.smallest_decisive_test: In an isolated fixture, add an unapproved ordinary public file and require rejection; otherwise retain an explicit reviewed-public-input limit.

limits: No build, validator, browser, native probe or remote rerun by this reviewer
No secret-content audit, legal judgment, numerical PRD scoring, physical-device proof or protected visual holdout
